title: Uncarried-test closure line: report the other-grant reason first and give advice per reason
outcome: The closure line for a test left uncarried at a turn boundary names the reason that actually kept it from being carried, and its advice fits that reason.
acceptance: C1 (reason order at the close). engram_close_unended_checks knows the closing grant. At the turn's close, a check started under a grant other than the closing one is told ENGRAM_UNCARRIED_OTHER_GRANT, before any session-wide cause (agent, line key, carry refusal, runtime). At the next turn's start, a check that nothing about itself kept from being carried is told ENGRAM_UNCARRIED_UNRESOLVED_CLOSE, as now.

C2 (advice fits the reason). The generic "run it again to record it" is replaced by advice chosen per reason: Unnamed: "name the worktree with termal_name_source_root, then run it again in a later turn"; OutsideRoot: "run it again in the named source root"; Delegated: "ask the root session that holds the claim to run it in its named source root"; Overlapped: "run it again on its own"; Outstanding: no rerun advice, "it can earn credit only once Claude reports that work ended"; non-Codex runtime, line key, runtime gone, other grant, unresolved close: "run it again and let it end within its turn". The reason clause itself is unchanged from w-1b4f. No other line changes.

C3 (tests, absorbing w-c5c50). Table-driven regression tests through the real close paths assert each reason and its advice: at the turn's close for line key, unnamed, overlapped, Claude, runtime gone, delegated session, target outside the named root, an outstanding-work fence, and a check of another grant (OTHER_GRANT, and not a session-wide cause, even when one would also apply); at the next turn's start after a cached close, for an unnamed root and for a named root with a Codex item-keyed check (UNRESOLVED_CLOSE).

C4 (unchanged rules). Carried tests and the background-gate refusal lines (EngramCarryRefusal::gate_line) are unchanged word for word, and the existing reported_ends, unended_closures and silent_check_outcome tests pass unchanged except where they assert the replaced generic advice; any such expectation is named with its justification.
C5 (validation). The review pair has no outstanding finding of Medium or higher; focused checks pass on the frozen input; it lands after w-1b4f and w-e11e.
